messages:
sophia_support: FYI support tickets showing 500s from /v1/rate/check instead of 429. Started ~10:12 PDT. Example response: 500 {"error":"internal"} for tenant=acct-9234. Customers hitting throttles are getting 5xx, causing retries and billing spikes.

raj_oncall: Ack. Any quick repro steps or curl we can share?

sophia_support: repro curl below (redacted token):
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rate/check \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acct-9234","route":"/v1/generate","tokens":1200}'
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 500
{"error":"internal"}

Logs from gateway (snippet):
```
2026-03-17T17:11:54Z ratefront[pid=211] ERROR handleRateCheck - upstreamTimeout: requestId=abc-123 tenant=acct-9234 dep=quota-orch
2026-03-17T17:11:54Z ratefront[pid=211] ERROR mapRateError - unexpected exception mapping status -> throwing 500
```
deploy-bot: quota-orch autoscaler restarted 2 pods at 2026-03-17T17:12:01Z due to cpu spike.

ivan_sre: I pulled quota-orch logs — seeing repeated socket timeouts to quota-db (10.0.12.8:6379). Timeouts are ~150-300ms. The quota-orch path is throwing TimeoutException which bubbles to ratefront and becomes 500 because we don't map dependency timeouts to 429 here.

maria_eng: Confirmed. There's a codepath where TimeoutException isn't converted to a soft-throttle. I'll open a hotfix to catch QuotaTimeout and return 429 with body {"error":"quota_exceeded"} when appropriate.

jen_support_lead: Which customers impacted and severity? We need comms if billing affected.

sophia_support: Impacted tenants from incoming tickets: acct-9234, acct-1201, acct-551. Putting this P2 for now — several retries already observed causing token overage alarms.

raj_oncall: Short-term mitigation: infra can enable fallback route("fallback-ratecheck") that returns 429 on upstream timeouts instead of throwing 500. Rolling that now for high-volume tenants. Will also bump quota-orch replicas 4->8. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: route-config change applied for tenants [acct-9234,acct-1201,acct-551]. rollout status: 2/3 workers updated.

ivan_sre: After scaling replicas I'm seeing 90% drop in 500s from ratefront but still a residual spike on the auth refresh path (/v1/auth/refresh) where a cold-cache calls quota-orch synchronously. Those still show 500s while the fix lands.

maria_eng: I pushed 1.2.3-hotfix branch with a try/catch to map QuotaTimeout -> 429 + metrics tag quota_timeout=true. Requesting review from ratefront owners. If approved, we'll ship canary in 30m.

jen_support_lead: Good. Sophia, please update the affected tickets with the workaround (fallback route enabled) and ETA ~1hr for canary deploy. Also please escalate any billing disputes to finance.

sophia_support: Updated tickets and emailed top 3 contacts. No billing disputes yet, but asked them to suspend automated retries. Will follow up after canary.

ivan_sre: Action items: 1) keep fallback route in place until patch verified; 2) investigate redis timeouts — increase connection pool and tune timeouts; 3) add alert when quota-orch returns >1% 5xx in a 5m window.

maria_eng: I'll open PR for mapping + unit test and add integration test to simulate quota-db latency.

raj_oncall: Marking oncall:ivan_sre for follow-up and oncall:maria_eng for deploy.

sophia_support: Posting customer comms link in support tickets and creating incident doc + postmortem stub.

jen_support_lead: Thanks team. We'll keep this thread for the postmortem notes. :handshake:
